description: beads-sigma-htu7 regression: a SINGLE-SOURCE custom-SQL datasource (one object-model type='text' relation, no blend) must migrate. Before the fix the lone kind:sql element was unnamed and its columns kept [Custom SQL/<caption>] self-refs (display names, not the raw SQL output names) -> DM POST 400 'dependency not found: custom sql/<col>'. Fix names it 'Custom SQL' and remaps formulas to the raw output names via colSqlNameById. Targets TJ.PUBLIC.SUPERSTORE_ORDERS for portability.
